stem.en: Your textbook suggests a 2 % m/v salt solution as the solvent for green food colour. A student needs 50 mL of this solution. How many grams of salt must the student weigh out?

explanation.en: 2 % m/v means 2 g of salt in every 100 mL of solution. 50 mL is half of 100 mL, so it needs half of 2 g, which is **1 g**. To make it, dissolve the 1 g in some water, then add water until the total volume is 50 mL. The 50 mL is the finished solution, not the water you start with.

hints.en: What does 2 % m/v mean for every 100 mL of solution?
50 mL is what fraction of 100 mL?
